user.title: Forest fire danger in Québec
user.description: How do you want to choose the place to follow? You can add other places later (a cottage, for example).

menu_options.location: Geolocate: a point on the map (your home to start with)
menu_options.zone: Choose a SOPFEU fire danger zone

location.title: Geolocate
location.description: Move the marker if needed. SOPFEU finds the fire danger zone of this point and the preventive measures in effect right there.

data_description.threshold: The Alert sensor turns on when today's danger reaches this level. Use it to show a card only when the risk is real.
data_description.fire_ban: Also turn the Alert sensor on while an open-fire ban applies, whatever the danger.

municipality.title: Municipality
municipality.description: Type to search. Your home's municipality is preselected. A large municipality can span several zones: the sensors show the highest danger.
